knowledge_gaps: Bounding the gate does not bound the residual’s effect: embedding norms and joint training can change its scale relative to SASRec features. Specify normalization, embedding scaling, regularization, and norm diagnostics.

The causal pooling concept is clear, but exact handling of padding, repeated IDs, truncated histories, and per-position versus final-position scoring remains unspecified. Training, diagnostic, and generated predictor outputs need numerical parity checks.

A positive recent-item residual may reinforce similarity to already purchased items—the same failure described in the feedback. Compare against a last-item residual and longer-history pooling before attributing gains to recent, narrow intent.

The validation decision rule lacks uncertainty reporting and checkpoint-selection details. With 200 users per category, small improvements can reflect sampling variability; disabling the gate after joint training also does not reproduce an independently trained baseline.

Originality 4/10 and difficulty 4/10 are reasonable provisional ratings. Potential 7/10 is optimistic without measured gains or evidence that this intervention addresses the diagnosed failures. The required full-catalog audit for five training users per category also needs an explicit procedure.
